slides.subtitle:
CPAT Workshop -- Draft Findings
October 2026
slides.notes: Welcome the group and set expectations for the session.

slides.title: Why consider a carbon tax now?

bullets.text: Uzbekistan's emissions intensity is above the regional average
Energy subsidies currently blunt price signals for households and firms
A phased carbon tax ($5 in 2027 rising to $20 in 2030) is evaluated using CPAT
Revenue recycling options can offset distributional impacts on poorer households
Source: CPAT model runs, World Bank staff estimates

slides.notes: Emphasize this is a policy option, not a recommendation.
